description: Hold-out genuine case, written blind from the brief's family description. The message is simulated and the people in it are illustrative. An expensive item arrived water-damaged; the payer sends a photo and asks for a refund. The photo is an illustrative drawing.

messages.body: Hello, the floor basket from order KIK-1037 came soaked through and now has mould spots on the base. Photo attached. Please refund it.
